integrity: Analytical proof and standard-library exact-rational checker included; the computer checker samples finitely many rational instances and does not independently prove the all-real claim.
scientific_limitations: Three-player unweighted triangle, per-vertex opposite-action rewards, generic distinct types; uniform i.i.d. distribution only for the exact one-quarter probability. No extension to arbitrary graphs, arbitrary edge-specific payoffs, or nongeneric ties.
title: A median–midpoint law for welfare instability in heterogeneous triangle anti-coordination
